visual_action: Rep. Maxwell Frost gives a tour of a Capitol building hallway to internet streamer IShowSpeed. The footage is framed as a livestream, with a viewer/engagement counter and a chat log visible in the top right corner. They walk up a flight of stairs and down a hall, with Frost explaining his job. At the end, Frost points to the official plaque outside his office door which shows his name.

cast.evidence: His name appears on an office plaque that he points to. On-screen text also reads "Rep. Frost". The caption names "@Congressman Maxwell Frost".

cast.name: Vote.org
cast.evidence: Maxwell Frost repeatedly mentions the website, saying, "which vote.org... that's where you go to register to vote."

on_screen_text.text: Rep. Frost shows Speed's chat how to register to vote

spoken_summary: Rep. Maxwell Frost explains to internet streamer IShowSpeed that as a congressman, he divides his year between Washington D.C. and his home district of Orlando, Florida. Frost then mentions that he travels to encourage young people to register to vote, and he repeatedly plugs the website vote.org as the place to do so. He concludes by showing Speed the plaque outside his office bearing his name.
audio_music: The audio consists solely of dialogue between the two men and ambient sounds of them walking through the building. There is no music or other sound design.
editing_pacing: The video is presented as a single, continuous shot that follows the two subjects as they walk and talk, characteristic of a livestream clip.
cultural_references: The video features a collaboration with IShowSpeed (referred to as 'Speed'), a very popular internet personality and streamer.

The video's format adopts the aesthetics of a livestream, including an on-screen chat box and a large numerical counter, referencing online streaming culture popular on platforms like YouTube and Twitch.
central_claim: Rep. Maxwell Frost is an accessible politician who is actively trying to engage young people in the political process by encouraging them to register to vote via vote.org.
intended_effect: To make young viewers feel that Rep. Frost is relatable and understands their culture, thereby encouraging them to register to vote.
uncertainty_flags: The text in the livestream's chat log in the corner of the screen is too small and blurry to read.
